answer: A nebula of fake agents looks dense but proves hollow once every identity must lock a refundable stake: require each agent to bond 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, slashed in full on proven sybil behaviour. Spinning up 1,000 sock puppets then costs 500,000 POA locked, while one honest pearl of an agent risks nothing by behaving well, so the attack costs more than any reward it could farm.
